description: Template defining what each YNAB budget category covers. Used to categorize transactions from multi-category payees like Target, Amazon, and Walmart. The payee lists below are illustrative placeholders - copy this file to category_definitions.json and replace them with the merchants that actually appear in your budget.

Auto: Repairs & Maintenance.description: Vehicle repairs, maintenance, inspections, registration, car washes

Clothing.description: Clothes, shoes, accessories. NOT costumes or uniforms (those go to business categories)

Coffee & Alcohol.description: Coffee shops, bars, breweries, wineries, alcohol purchases. NOT dining meals at places that also serve drinks

Concerts.description: Concert and live music event tickets, parking at venues

Dining Out.description: Restaurant meals, fast food, drive-throughs, bakeries, food trucks. The meal itself, not drinks-only outings (those go to Coffee & Alcohol)

Dining: Celebration Meals.description: Special occasion meals - birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, date nights. Higher-end or intentionally planned

Donations.description: Charitable donations, Goodwill drop-offs, Scout support, fundraisers

Gifts & Holidays: General.description: Non-Christmas, non-birthday gifts. Easter supplies, Valentine's Day, Mother's/Father's Day, hostess gifts, party supplies, greeting cards, gift wrapping

Groceries.description: Food and beverages for home consumption. Grocery store trips. NOT household supplies bought at grocery stores (cleaning products, paper goods go to Home: Household Supplies)

Haircuts.description: Haircuts and hair styling for family members

Hobbies & Recreation.description: Hobby supplies, recreational activities, scrapbooking, outdoor recreation, gardens/attractions admission. NOT plants or yard supplies (those go to Yard & Outdoor)

Home: Decor.description: Decorative items - throw pillows, wall art, picture frames, vases, candles (decorative), seasonal decor, curtains, rugs. Items whose primary purpose is aesthetic

Home: Furniture.description: Furniture purchases - tables, chairs, couches, beds, shelving units, ottomans, desks

Home: Household Supplies.description: Consumable and functional household items - cleaning products, paper towels, trash bags, light bulbs, batteries, storage containers, baskets, organizers, air fresheners, candles (functional), laundry supplies, pest control products, small bathroom/kitchen items (plunger, soap dispenser). Items that are used up or serve a purely functional purpose

Home: Projects.description: Home improvement projects - painting, flooring, built-ins, shelving installation, renovation materials. Distinct from repairs (broken things) and maintenance (ongoing upkeep)

Home: Repairs & Maintenance.description: Fixing broken things and scheduled maintenance - plumbing, HVAC, pest control service, appliance repair, window repair, junk removal

Home: Tools.description: Durable tools and equipment for home use - power tools, hand tools, drill bits, tool accessories, work gloves, safety equipment. NOT garden-specific tools (those go to Yard & Outdoor)

Home: Yard & Outdoor Maintenance.description: Yard and garden - plants (ornamental AND edible), mulch, soil, fertilizer, garden tools, seeds, pots, planters, lawn care service, outdoor furniture care, patio items, bird feeders, yard decor

Medical & Dental.description: Doctor visits, dental, prescriptions, medical equipment, health supplements, Weight Watchers, therapy, urgent care

Personal Care.description: Toiletries, skincare, makeup, hygiene products, grooming supplies. NOT salon services (those go to Haircuts or Spa & Nails)

Personal Care: Spa & Nails.description: Nail salon, spa services, massage, facials

Pet Care: Food & Supplies.description: Pet food, treats, toys, beds, leashes, collars, litter, grooming supplies

Pet Care: Vet & Medical.description: Vet visits, pet medications, pet insurance, pet health products

Random - Oh Shit!.description: Unexpected, unplanned expenses that don't fit elsewhere. Impulse buys, things you forgot to budget for, oddball purchases

Subscriptions (Personal).description: Recurring personal subscriptions - streaming, apps, memberships

Tech Purchases.description: Electronics, gadgets, computer accessories, cables, tech gear

disambiguation_rules.rule: Home Depot default is Home: Yard & Outdoor Maintenance unless memo indicates tools, repair materials, or home improvement project supplies
Target default is based on memo - most Target trips are split transactions across multiple categories
Amazon default is based on memo - Amazon purchases span nearly every category
Sam's Club and Costco are typically Groceries unless memo specifies otherwise (clothing, household, pet, etc.)
Walmart default is Groceries unless memo indicates otherwise
Garden plants (including edible vegetables and herbs) go to Home: Yard & Outdoor Maintenance, NOT Groceries. Groceries is for food ready to consume or cook, not plants to grow
Garden supplies (fertilizer, soil, plant food, garden gloves) go to Home: Yard & Outdoor Maintenance, NOT Home: Tools or Home: Household Supplies
